documents.text: A brisk walk improves cardiovascular fitness and mood.
Strength training builds muscle and supports bone health.
Sourdough bread uses a fermented starter and a long rise.
Whole grain flour adds fiber and a nutty flavor to bread.
Paris is the capital of France, known for the Seine and the Eiffel Tower.
The Louvre is a major art museum in central Paris.
Tomatoes need warm weather, sunlight, and regular watering.
Compost improves garden soil by adding organic matter.
Mars is a rocky planet with a thin carbon dioxide atmosphere.
The James Webb Space Telescope observes distant galaxies in infrared.
A piano produces sound when hammers strike stretched strings.
Jazz improvisation often uses syncopated rhythms and extended chords.
A warm front brings rising temperatures and may produce steady rain.
Hurricanes form over warm ocean water and rotate around a calm eye.
A binary search repeatedly halves a sorted list to find a value.
Unit tests check small pieces of software against expected results.
